prompt: Summarize what was decided in the following meeting notes, in 2-3 sentences for the project record.
input_text: During the kickoff meeting for the Northwind Logistics project, a three-phase rollout was approved, beginning with a discovery phase in April, a pilot at the Hai Phong depot in early May, followed by a review before broader deployment. It was emphasized that the warehouse management system must be on-premise and comply with security protocols, with an initial budget of up to $50,000 contingent on finance committee approval based on pilot outcomes in June. Action items were assigned for updating the project schedule, confirming coordinators, and documenting technical requirements.
output_text: During the kickoff meeting for the Northwind Logistics project, a three-phase rollout was approved, starting with a discovery phase in April, followed by a pilot at the Hai Phong depot in early May, and a subsequent review before broader deployment. The project will utilize an on-premise warehouse management system adhering to security protocols, with an initial budget of up to $50,000 pending finance committee approval based on pilot results in June. Action items were assigned to update the project schedule, confirm coordinators, and document technical requirements.
